title: Decisions, Courage, and Action: Real Stories of Choosing What Matters, Moving Through Fear
description: What have you been putting off until you feel ready? You may have a project you keep revisiting, a conversation you're avoiding, or a trip you've promised yourself for years. Waiting has a cost, even when it feels like the sensible choice. Decisions, Courage, and Action brings together ten authors with real stories and practical approaches to decision-making, leadership, personal growth, and following through. Compiled by Robert Plank, this collection explores how to choose what matters when fear, exhaustion, competing demands, and rapid change make the next step difficult. Rita Ainsworth describes the moment she could see the numbers on her advertising dashboard but could no longer understand them. Mitch Slater recalls accepting a million-dollar check as a young financial advisor and learning what another person's trust required of him. WL Gertz returns to poetry after almost fifty years, with a reminder to pursue the experiences you've been postponing. Alongside these stories, you'll discover how to: Make better decisions with AI. Speed up research and execution while keeping responsibility for the result. Recognize the cost of overworking. Explore stress management, boundaries, and a more sustainable relationship with ambition. Lead people through change. Ask better questions, communicate expectations, and understand what's behind resistance. Build relationships that last. Listen closely, educate before you sell, and earn trust through follow-through. Finish what matters. Use Donna Blevins's three small daily wins and Robert Plank's Five Boxes approach to break difficult projects into manageable steps. Make room for life beyond work. title: The Mastery of Self: A Toltec Guide to Personal Freedom (Toltec Mastery Series)
description: Renowned Toltec wisdom teacher don Miguel Ruiz Jr. reveals how the tools of awareness, understanding, and unconditional love can free your authentic self. The Toltecs were an ancient civilization that predated the Aztecs. They believed that life as we perceive it is a dream. We each live in our own personal dream, and our collective dreams come together to shape the “Dream of the Planet.” But problems arise when we forget that the dream is just that—a dream, and not a fixed reality. The Mastery of Self takes the Toltec philosophy of the “Dream of the Planet” and the personal dream and explains how we can: Wake up from our illusions Liberate ourselves from the inhibiting stories we all tell ourselves Live as our true, authentic, loving selves Once released, we can live our authentic lives not only in solitude and meditation but anywhere—at the grocery store, stuck in traffic, and so forth—and in any situation or scenario that might confront us. Each chapter includes rituals, meditations, and other practices to manifest Toltec wisdom in our lives.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_3"]', '#CardInstanceQjJHWK2eeGTUUQhSs37ONQ')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_3',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:

title: Leadership and Strategy for Successful Black Business Women: Unleashing Your Inner Strengt
description: Tired of being underestimated, overworked, and overlooked? Ready to stop shrinking and step into the powerhouse leader you’re meant to be? You’ve worked hard, broken barriers, and built your success—but you're still expected to prove yourself over and over again. Leadership isn’t about playing by rules that weren’t designed for you. It’s about owning your power , making bold moves, and stepping into the leadership role you deserve—without sacrificing your peace, authenticity, or ambition. This book is your roadmap to becoming the leader you were born to be. Written specifically for Black women navigating corporate spaces, entrepreneurship, and executive leadership, this guide blends real-world strategy with cultural insight so you can move from overlooked to unstoppable. Inside, you’ll discover how to: Command any room with confidence—Speak up, be heard, and own your presence. Master leadership strategy like a CEO—Make bold, intentional moves that elevate your career or business. Turn obstacles into opportunities—Overcome bias, imposter syndrome, and workplace politics like a pro. Build a network that actually supports you—Surround yourself with power players, mentors, and allies. Achieve success without burnout—Set boundaries, protect your energy, and lead without losing yourself. Think leadership success is only for those with elite connections or decades of experience? Think again. You can rise to the top—even if you’re the only Black woman in the room. Even if you've doubted your place at the table. Even if you've been told to “tone it down.” Your voice, vision, and leadership are needed. Now is your time—step into your power today.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstanceuoKKaKI1tgckGac5XdoG_A')('mark',

title: Stop Letting Everything Affect You: How to break free from overthinking, emotional chaos,
description: STOP LETTING EVERYTHING AFFECT YOU is a transformative guide for anyone who overthinks too often, gets stuck in emotional chaos, and finds themselves trapped in cycles of self-sabotage. With raw honesty and practical wisdom, Daniel Chidiac reveals why small things ruin your entire day and offers proven strategies to finally break free. This book will teach you how to: Stop letting little things ruin your entire day. Stop self-sabotaging. Set healthy boundaries without feeling guilty. Recognize the difference between real guilt and manipulation. Break the cycle of overthinking before it spirals out of control. Stop taking everything so personally and free yourself from emotional reactivity. Identify toxic patterns in relationships and walk away without regret. Be more in control and feel better everyday. Shift your mindset from victimhood to self-empowerment. Learn the art of emotional detachment—how to be unbothered without becoming cold. Move forward unapologetically, without feeling the need to explain your growth. Whether you're exhausted from overthinking everything, tired of absorbing everyone else's energy, or simply ready to stop letting life's chaos dictate how you feel, this book offers the transformative tools to finally reclaim your power, protect your peace, and live on your own terms. Your journey to inner strength and freedom starts here. Daniel Chidiac , International best-selling author of Who Says You Can't? You Do and The Modern Break-Up brings his new book, Stop Letting Everything Affect You . description: As a black woman, you've navigated a world that often overlooks your struggles and diminishes your worth. With her guidance, you'll discover how to rise above the challenges that have held you back and step into your power as a black woman.
